description: List protocol packages from desktop/src/core/registry.json with each package's id, version, module count, and categories. Use it for the authoritative protocol package catalog; do not use it to search modules (registry_search) or pipelines (pipeline_list), and do not treat protocol hits from registry_search as a substitute for this list. Takes no arguments; an empty list means the registry declares no protocols. Reads one local file deterministically; a missing or malformed registry is an error. Packages appear in registry order.
name: spec_list

outputSchema.description: Wrapper for the protocol package list; the payload is in items.

items.description: Registered protocol packages in registry order.

categories.description: Package category labels; empty when undeclared.

modules.description: Number of module IDs bound to the package.

title: List protocol packages
